query: In my project notes, which Groq model was retired, and on what date?

checks.pattern: (16 august|august 16|2026-08-16|16th of august|august 16th|august sixteenth|sixteenth of august)

pass_examples: Groq retired llama-3.1-8b-instant on the sixteenth of August, 2026.
fail_examples: I believe it was an older llama model, retired some time last year.

query: According to my notes, how many characters can a question have before my API rejects it?
pass_examples: Questions longer than 2000 characters are rejected.
Questions longer than two thousand characters are rejected.
fail_examples: There is no limit on question length.

query: In my project, what is the longest password allowed, and why?
pass_examples: 72 bytes, because bcrypt cannot use more than 72 bytes.
Seventy-two bytes, because bcrypt cannot use more than that.
fail_examples: There is no limit on password length.
